ORDINANCE I OF 2018
ORDINANCE I OF 2018
CAPITAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2018
An Ordinance further to amend the Capital
Development
Authority Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part-I,
11th January, 2018]
No.
F. 2(1)/2018-Pub., dated 10.1.2018.---The
following Ordinance Promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Capital Development Authority Ordinance,
1960 (XXIII of 1960) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
AND
WHEREAS the Senate and the National Assembly are not in session;
AND
WHEREAS the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
THEREFORE in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance, namely:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Capital Development Authority (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 6, Ordinance XXIII of 1960

AND
WHEREAS the Senate and the National Assembly are not in session;
AND
WHEREAS the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
THEREFORE in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance, namely:-
2. Amendment
of section 6, Ordinance XXIII of 1960.---In the Capital Development Authority Ordinance, 1960 (XXIII of 1960),
hereinafter called as the said Ordinance, in section 6--
(a) in
subsection (2), after the word "member", the expression "Who are
civil servants in BS-20 and above" shall be inserted;
(b) for
subsection (3), the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(3)
The Chairman and other members shall, unless sooner removed for reasons to be
recorded in writing, hold office for a period of three years."; and
(c) for
subsection (6), the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(6)
A member, who is not a civil servant of the Federal Government, may at any time
in writing under his hand addressed to the Federal Government resign:
Provided
that his resignation shall not take effect until accepted by the Federal
Government.".
